source_name: NBRSM — Платежна статистика (Payment Statistics), Macedonian page
why_relevant: Central-bank landing page for the legally mandated payment statistics: payment transactions per type of terminal (ATM/POS/imprinter/other), number and value of card transactions, participation in payment systems, payments processed by payment systems, and fees. Macedonian version historically carries the fullest set of downloadable tables.

source_name: NBRSM — Payment Statistics (English page)
why_relevant: English mirror of the payment statistics section; states the dissemination calendar (quarterly data within 90 days of quarter end, annual within 90 days of year end) and exposes tables on payment transactions per terminal type and total value of card transactions at POS. Useful for machine-readable, English-labelled series and for confirming release timing.

source_name: NBRSM — Платежни картички (Payment Cards)
why_relevant: Dedicated card-instrument page of the central bank: issued cards by type/brand, card acceptance network, and card-transaction context. Core for card-market sizing and issuer/acquirer landscape.

source_name: NBRSM — Report on payment cards (historical PDF series, WBStorage)
why_relevant: Concrete example of the central bank's card-report PDF series stored under the /WBStorage/Files/ path with a 'Platni sistemi_' prefix — evidence of a predictable file-naming pattern that can be enumerated for the historical card/ATM/POS report back-catalogue.

source_name: NBRSM — МИПС (Macedonian Interbank Payment System) section
why_relevant: Owner/operator page for MIPS, the RTGS system for large-value and urgent interbank payments. Source of MIPS turnover/volume statistics, participants, accounts and operating schedule — the backbone series for wholesale payment activity.

source_name: NBRSM — КИБС (Clearing Interbank Systems) page
why_relevant: Central-bank description and oversight view of KIBS, the multilateral deferred net settlement system for small-value payments (participants: banks, Treasury, Health Insurance Fund; net settlement daily 14:30-15:30 in MIPS). Anchor for retail payment-volume statistics and for identifying KIBS AD Skopje as a separate direct source.

source_name: NBRSM — Македонска платежна инфраструктура (Macedonian Payment Infrastructure)
why_relevant: Structural map of the national payment infrastructure (MIPS, KIBS, card schemes, processors). Best single page for actor mapping and for snowballing to non-central-bank operators relevant to ATM/POS estate analysis.

source_name: NBRSM — Регистар/список на платежни институции, институции за електронски пари и оператори на платни системи
why_relevant: Statutory register of licensed payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment system operators. Highest-value pointer source in the cell: converts the regulatory perimeter into a named actor list for further source discovery (fintechs, acquirers, processors).

source_name: NBRSM — Податоци и показатели за банкарскиот систем на РСМ / Banking System of RNM
why_relevant: Quarterly bank-by-bank and aggregate banking-system indicator tables (assets, loans, deposits, capital, profitability). Baseline denominator data for any payments/market-share analysis and for bank prioritisation.

source_name: NBRSM — Banking System Reports (quarterly, English)
why_relevant: Narrative quarterly/annual reports on the banking system, typically containing sections on payment cards, digital channels and bank infrastructure alongside balance-sheet analysis. English text makes it directly usable for briefing output.

source_name: NBRSM — Извештаи за финансиската стабилност / Financial Stability Reports
why_relevant: Annual financial stability report; recurring chapters on payment system risk, operational/cyber risk in payments, household payment behaviour and cash usage. Rich for qualitative trend framing that raw tables do not give.

source_name: NBRSM — Годишни извештаи / Annual Reports (institutional)
why_relevant: The National Bank's annual report contains the statutory account of payment-system operation and oversight for the year (MIPS/KIBS turnover, card infrastructure, currency issuance), often the only consolidated annual narrative on these series. Direct PDF pattern confirmed (e.g. /content/Annual_Report_2020.pdf).

source_name: NBRSM — Квартални извештаи (Quarterly Reports)
why_relevant: Quarterly macro/monetary reports giving the most timely official commentary on currency in circulation and deposit dynamics — the fastest official read on cash usage between annual publications.

source_name: NBRSM — Монетарна статистика / Monetary and interest rate statistics
source_subtype: statistical section with XLSX time series
why_relevant: Monthly monetary statistics including currency in circulation as a component of M1 — the canonical cash-usage series, plus deposit-institution balance sheets used to benchmark cash vs account money.

source_name: NBStat — National Bank statistical web portal (PxWeb, with API)
why_relevant: Machine-readable PxWeb dissemination platform (Eurostat-style) with a documented API. Verified in this pass to expose three database trees: External Statistics, Financial Accounts, and Monetary and Interest Rates Statistics — the latter carries broad money and its components, i.e. currency in circulation. The single best automatable ingestion point for NBRSM series.

source_name: NBRSM — Книжни пари во оптек / Ковани пари во оптек (banknotes and coins in circulation)
why_relevant: Currency-issuance pages covering banknotes and coins in circulation, denominational structure and new issues. Direct evidence base for cash-usage and cash-cycle analysis (ATM cash demand, denomination mix).

source_name: NBRSM — Соопштенија за печат: монетарни движења (monthly press releases, /content/statistika/Soopstenija/)
source_subtype: static file directory / press-release PDF series
why_relevant: Monthly statistical press releases published as PDFs under a highly predictable path pattern (…/Soopstenija/MD/YYYY/Soopstenie_za_pecat_monetarni_dvizenja_YYYY_<month>_mk.pdf). Earliest official signal each month on money/currency developments, and the file-path pattern makes automated harvesting cheap and robust to the site's bot defences.

source_name: NBRSM — Регулатива за платните системи и платежните услуги + Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи
why_relevant: The Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems and its by-laws define WHAT must be reported by banks and operators and on what cadence — i.e. the reporting obligations that generate the payment/card/ATM/POS statistics. Essential for knowing which datasets must exist and when they must appear, and for anticipating new series (PSD2-aligned reporting).

source_name: NBRSM — Национален совет за платните системи (National Payment System Council)
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder council (central bank, banks, Treasury, card/processing actors) whose agendas, strategies and minutes reveal forward-looking payments initiatives (instant payments, card scheme moves, cash strategy) before they appear in statistics. Also a strong actor-map pointer. A national payment system development strategy PDF is published under /WBStorage/Files/.

source_name: NBRSM — Статистика hub (MK) / Statistics hub (EN)
why_relevant: Top-level index of every statistical domain the central bank publishes (monetary, payment, external, financial accounts, banking indicators) plus the release calendar and methodology notes. The canonical crawl entry point for the whole cell and for detecting newly added datasets.

source_name: NBRSM — Финансискиот систем во Република Северна Македонија (financial system overview)
why_relevant: Structural overview of the financial system: institution counts by type, market structure and supervisory perimeter. Useful for context and for enumerating non-bank actors adjacent to payments.

source_name: NBRSM — Менувачници (registry of licensed exchange offices)
why_relevant: Register of licensed currency exchange offices supervised by the central bank — an indirect indicator of cash-handling intensity and of the physical cash economy footprint, relevant to cash-usage trend analysis.

source_name: Државен завод за статистика (State Statistical Office) — main site
why_relevant: National statistical authority; entry point to all releases (соопштенија), methodological notes, publication calendar and the MAKStat database. Resolves which statistical domains exist for retail trade, ICT/e-commerce, household budgets and business demography relevant to payments demand.

source_name: MAKStat PxWeb statistical database (ДЗС)
why_relevant: Machine-readable time series across all SSO domains, incl. internal trade (Внатрешна трговија) retail turnover by region and product group, ICT usage, household budget survey. Documented download formats (PC-Axis, XLSX, CSV, JSON) and a public API — the single best structured feed in this cell for retail/e-commerce denominators used to size card and cash payment markets.

source_name: ДЗС — Користење на информатичко-комуникациски технологии во домаќинствата и од поединците (ICT usage by households and individuals)
why_relevant: The Eurostat-aligned annual ICT household survey is the only official national measure of online purchasing, internet banking and online payment behaviour by individuals — the demand-side complement to central-bank card statistics.

source_name: ДЗС — Користење на ИКТ во деловните субјекти (ICT usage in enterprises, incl. e-commerce sales)
why_relevant: Enterprise-side ICT/e-commerce survey covering share of firms selling online and receiving online payments (non-financial sector, 10+ employees) — the merchant-acceptance denominator for POS/e-commerce acquiring analysis.

source_name: ДЗС — Промет во трговијата на мало и на големо (retail & wholesale turnover releases + methodology)
why_relevant: Monthly retail/wholesale turnover indices — the standard macro proxy for card-payment volume growth and for cash-vs-card mix trend work; the methodological note page documents coverage and base year.

source_name: ДЗС — Отворени податоци / Open Data API
why_relevant: SSO's own open-data/API endpoint listing — a lower-friction machine ingest path than HTML scraping for release metadata and datasets.
